scope: Deep simplification of Testnet exchange execution from approved alert; isolated, not deployed
changes: Remove live entry capacity survey: no userAbstraction, userRole(account), activeAssetData, spot balance or separate margin/leverage computation
Entry account evidence now contains only fresh agent-to-account binding and unchanged exit-action headroom; exchange margin rejection is recorded, never blindly retried
Retain original alert prices, quantity risk/precision/notional bounds, per-account isolation, durable deduplication, partial-fill protection and unknown-outcome reconciliation
Reuse one validated market sample between adjacent execution steps for less than five seconds; preserve original timestamp
Skip fill-history reads for exact unchanged owned orders and position under continuous feed; refresh history at fixed 30-second boundaries with overlap anchored to previous boundary
Notifications, restart, partial changes and unresolved sends force full history; unchanged protected monitoring takes two reads between history audits
Flat-position leftover cancellation uses order identity and asset metadata without a live market-price dependency
Delete obsolete account_preflight function and replace provider _capacity including its nested RecordingReader with minimal _entry_account
limitations: Offline deterministic exchange replay, not live Testnet proof; no real exchange calls or live database reads
557 PostgreSQL-dependent tests skipped, not counted as passes; no schema changes
Margin and current venue buying-power acceptance now belongs to the exchange; insufficient-margin refusal was verified to be recorded without repeated entry
Unchanged history audits run every 30-second boundary; quantity/feed changes and restart trigger immediate full read
Heavy withheld-fill scenario now completes two trades: 146 reads/1762 weight versus previous incomplete one-trade 107/1735; these are not equal-work reductions
All previously completing replay scenarios improved; arbitrary load is not guaranteed and ordinary exchange quota enforcement remains
Market samples retain their original timestamps and may be reused for less than five seconds
deployment: Specific approval required by repository AGENTS.md; no live branch or runtime settings changed
